title: Granite Query
subtitle: Learning More from Less
research_question: Can student aware data selection help Granite learn mathematical reasoning from DeepSeek more efficiently than random selection?
next_action: Poll the existing ranked/random call with cloud/comparison_control.py poll, then summarize outcomes and limitations.
caveat: Teacher pilot uses training questions. It is not held-out accuracy or evidence of Granite improvement.

events.title: Teacher API pilot completed
events.detail: All 16 seeded GSM8K training questions received DeepSeek responses. Fifteen passed the strict verifier. No test questions or Granite training were used.

events.title: Correct answer rejected for currency formatting
events.detail: One solution ended with a dollar sign before 13. The strict numeric parser rejected it; this is a formatting rejection, not evidence of incorrect arithmetic. Original output retained.

events.title: Sandbox network failure resolved
events.detail: The first connectivity attempt failed to resolve the provider hostname. The authorized network-enabled retry verified both services and completed the pilot.

events.title: Scheduled supervision enabled
events.detail: A recurring check is configured every 15 minutes, with durable local state and approximately hourly active progress reports. Local checks require the computer and app to remain running.

events.title: Public research journal and Pages preview
events.detail: Preparing an append-only activity history, generated journal, and public dashboard. Publication will be verified before being reported as live.

events.detail: The research dashboard is live. Browser verification confirmed the teacher pilot metrics, the journal links, and failure filtering. Scheduled supervision now includes append-only journal updates and public snapshot synchronization.

events.title: Granite LoRA smoke test prepared
events.detail: Pinned Granite 4.2 3B; 12 verified teacher training examples and 3 separate training-split development examples. One A100, 900-second limit, 3-dollar reservation. No held-out test data.

events.title: Modal launch compatibility issues resolved
events.detail: Corrected CLI module syntax and Windows console encoding. The workspace image builder was newer than the available SDK supports; a supported builder is selected explicitly. Empty apps were reconciled before retrying. The training image is building; no completed training is claimed.

events.title: Granite training job launched
events.detail: A detached Modal A100 worker is loading pinned Granite 4.2 3B. The smoke test uses 12 optimizer updates on 12 verified teacher examples, followed by adapter save/reload and three development checks. Execution limit: 900 seconds. Reserved budget: 3 dollars. No held-out test evaluation.

events.title: Granite training smoke test
events.detail: Review saved adapter and smoke-test results; reconcile costs before the controlled comparison.

events.title: Smoke-test results are not benchmark accuracy
events.detail: All 12 optimizer updates completed and adapter parameters changed. The saved adapter reloaded and all three development answers matched their reference numbers. Baseline responses were limited to 192 tokens and two were visibly truncated, so this tiny comparison cannot establish accuracy improvement. Preserve these outputs and use an adequate shared generation budget in the controlled experiment.

events.title: Ranked versus random comparison frozen
events.detail: 128 new candidate questions, 32 examples per arm, and 16 separate training-split development questions. Both arms start from pinned Granite 4.2 3B with identical LoRA settings. One seed; equal example counts, with actual token counts reported. Reserved 3 dollars DeepSeek and 3 dollars Modal. No official test data.

events.id: supervisor-next-Inspect the teacher collector lock and process; do not duplicate active generation. Resume only after confirming no collector is running.
events.title: Granite training smoke test
events.detail: Inspect the teacher collector lock and process; do not duplicate active generation. Resume only after confirming no collector is running.

events.title: Teacher collection passed the halfway point
events.detail: More than 64 of 128 candidate attempts have been saved. Rejected outputs remain preserved and excluded from both training arms. The experiment plan and numerical scoring policy are frozen before student evaluation.

events.title: Shared teacher pool generated
events.detail: Received 128 candidate attempts; 120 passed strict final-answer checks. Raw outputs and rejected records retained. The same eligible pool feeds both selectors.

events.title: Ranked and random subsets selected
events.detail: Selected 32 examples per arm from 120 identical eligible candidates. Overlap: 9 examples. BM25 uses frozen prompt-only relevance scores; random selection uses seed 42. Training and development IDs are disjoint.

events.title: Ranked versus random GPU worker launched
events.detail: A single detached A100 worker will evaluate the untouched model and train/evaluate two independent adapters sequentially. Each arm has 32 verified examples, with 9 shared examples. All use the same 16 development questions and 512-token generation cap. Current GPU reservation: 3 dollars.
